sources.pre_impact: What the rows show before the impact frame: 'blank' (blank_text) or 'live' (the same extractor evaluated at the frame being shown). Blank is the default: face angle, path, attack angle and loft are defined at impact, and their values at the top of the backswing are large numbers that mean nothing and draw the eye from the swing. From the impact frame on the impact values are frozen and stay to the end of the clip in both modes.
sources.blank_text: Text of a row that has no value yet, and of every row when no impact is known.
sources.rows: Card rows shown, in order, by the key of impact_parameters.panel_model.build_impact_card (which also gives labels and units). Unknown keys are refused.
sources.position: Frame edge the panel sits on: right or left.
sources.closest_approach_fallback: When the export knows no impact time (none given, none in the bundle, the detector found none): false shows 'no impact detected' and no numbers; true takes the instant after the top of the backswing at which the face centre is closest to the ball as the reference instant and labels the panel 'closest approach'. A face that passes the ball without touching it (strike point further than impact_card.MAX_FACE_OFFSET_M from the face centre) is always labelled 'closest approach, no contact' with the miss distance (face centre to ball centre).
sources.opacity: Darkening of the picture under the panel, 0 (none) to 1 (black); 0.62 is the impact card's value.
sources.font_height_divisor: Font size is the frame height divided by this (45, as the impact card).
sources.min_font_px: Smallest font size in pixels (11, as the impact card).
sources.grid_anchor: Where the panel (this one, and the impact card a clip draws when this panel is off) sits in the composed 2x2 grid export; single-view exports use position. The corner of the grid: bottom_right, bottom_left, top_right or top_left, so the panel lies inside one tile's corner and never spans two. bottom_right is the oblique tile's lower right: in the 1280x720 four-view clip of the reviewed driver swing it was empty ground at impact and through the follow-through and finish, while the top corners hold the down-the-line golfer, whom a frame-sized panel covered completely.
sources.grid_font_height_divisor: Grid font size is the composed frame height divided by this: 90 gives the size a single view has at its own height (tile height over 45), i.e. the panel shrinks from the frame-sized 32 px to the HUD text size.
sources.grid_min_font_px: Smallest grid font size in pixels, and the size the panel falls back to when it does not fit its tile; 16 is the HUD text size (compositor.HUD_SIZE_PX), so the panel text is never smaller than the HUD text.
sources.widest_value: Text the panel width is reserved for in every row, so live values cannot change the panel size.
